trigger: Reflexion rescue: PMID 23949920 — direct confirmation of YAP nuclear localization in human ILC (n=237, p<0.001), linked to CDH1/E-cadherin deficiency
claim: CDH1 loss in ILC activates YAP nuclear accumulation via dual mechanism, now directly confirmed in human ILC tumor tissue: (1) LATS deactivation — CDH1/p190A RhoGAP complex disrupted → LATS inactivated → YAP dephosphorylated → nuclear translocation (PMID 32641858); (2) PI3K-AKT crosstalk — PI3K amplification (common in CDK4/6i-resistant ILC) → AKT → YAP S127 dephosphorylation → nuclear accumulation (PMID 32816106). YAP nuclear localization is significantly higher in ILC than IDC in n=237 human cases (PMID 23949920, p<0.001), establishing ILC-specific YAP dependency. YAP-TEAD inhibition (verteporfin, IAG933) should show ILC-specific efficacy; alpelisib + verteporfin combination is the actionable next step in CDH1-loss CDK4/6i-resistant ILC.

ilc_specific_rescue.citation: Vlug EJ et al. Cell Oncol (Dordr). 2013 Aug;36(4):285-96
ilc_specific_rescue.title: Nuclear localization of the transcriptional coactivator YAP is associated with invasive lobular breast cancer
ilc_specific_rescue.key_finding: YAP nuclear localization is significantly higher in ILC (p<0.001) across n=237 human breast cancer cases. Directly linked to reduced CDH1/E-cadherin expression. ILC-specific, not seen at same frequency in IDC.
ilc_specific_rescue.significance: BRIDGE PAPER — closes the key gap in v1 ('CDH1→LATS→YAP not directly demonstrated in ILC breast cancer'). This is direct human tissue confirmation, not a mechanistic extrapolation from general carcinoma or non-mammary tissue.

evidence.finding: YAP nuclear localization significantly elevated in ILC vs IDC (n=237, p<0.001), linked to CDH1 deficiency. Direct human tissue evidence.
CDH1/E-cadherin loss → p190A RhoGAP disruption → LATS inactivation → YAP nuclear accumulation. General carcinoma mechanism, now ILC-anchored by PMID 23949920.
PI3K-AKT → YAP S127 dephosphorylation → nuclear translocation in diabetic nephropathy mesangial cells. Established PI3K-YAP crosstalk mechanism.
CDH1 loss (>90% ILC), PI3K pathway activation (40-45% ILC), CDK4/6i resistance enrichment — all support the mechanistic chain.

gap_update.v1_gap: CDH1→LATS→YAP not directly demonstrated in ILC breast cancer; verteporfin + alpelisib combination not tested in ILC
gap_update.v2_gap_status: CDH1→YAP axis now DIRECTLY CONFIRMED in human ILC tissue (PMID 23949920, n=237). Remaining gap: verteporfin + alpelisib combination not tested in ILC — this is now the primary experimental target.

novelty.note: Alpelisib + verteporfin combination in CDH1-loss CDK4/6i-resistant ILC is novel; YAP-ILC link itself is now published but T-DXd connection is not

evidential_quality.note: Direct human ILC tissue evidence (PMID 23949920) closes the major gap; mechanistic arms 1+2 still extrapolated from non-ILC models

clinical_relevance.note: CDK4/6i-resistant ILC is a high-unmet-need clinical problem; alpelisib approved for PIK3CA-mutant BC — combination testable now

mechanistic_depth.note: CDH1→LATS→YAP chain confirmed in ILC tissue; LATS-specific mechanism in ILC cells not yet directly published

actionability.note: Two immediate experiments: (1) verteporfin IC50 in CDH1-loss vs CDH1-intact ILC cell lines; (2) alpelisib + verteporfin synergy in MCF7/MDA-MB-134 vs MDA-MB-231

safety_novelty.note: Verteporfin photodynamic toxicity known; combination with alpelisib PI3K-mediated immune effects needs monitoring
